title: Roasted Beet Tagine
description: A creative take on traditional Italian cuisine, combining roasted beets with the flavors of a tagine.
instructions: Wrap the beets in foil and roast for 45-50 minutes, or until tender.
While the beets are roasting, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the cumin and coriander, and cook for 1 minute.
Once the beets are done, let them cool slightly, then peel and slice.
Add the sliced beets to the pan with the garlic and spice mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
